units.rationale: Setup is idempotent because call 04 harness.reset-product-state@2 removes every library reference and folder and deletes both the enchron.* and the server-certificate-fingerprint.* managed defaults (TestCommandChannel.swift:1157-1171 with managedDefaultKeys at :199-205), so each attempt re-adds the source from nothing and the certificate alert call 13 taps is guaranteed to reappear rather than being skipped by a remembered trust decision. The credentials are owned by the host, not a human: host.preflight@1 check=webdav-regression writes .build/regression-remote-source/runtime.json whose address, user and password keys are in RUNTIME_DOCUMENT_KEYS (regression_remote_source.py:74-84), the three accessibility.type@2 calls read exactly those keys through the absolute textFile path _accessibility_type requires (regression_operation_adapter.py:781-793) with secret true on the password, and the adapter refuses a report whose generation differs from the runtime document (line 5115-5124). The one system dialog is a recorded external constraint, not a hidden human prompt: product.md:66 and features/remote-source-connection.md:39 both record that the first credential connect raises the Save Password sheet and that tap --label '以后' closes it synthetically, and reachability_matrix.py:2600 drives the identical tap. Every identifier the plan names resolves against Config/reachability_operation_inventory.json, and sdr-bframe-aggregate-30s.mkv at call 15 is REMOTE_PRIMARY_FILE_NAME, the file the WebDAV service actually serves. The output key webdav-test-source-ready with schema remote-source.webdav-fixture@2 is unique and reconstructible after a retry because the producing call 16 is the same preflight run again, and validate_remote_preflight_report (line 1710-1740) pins endpointDigest, certificateFingerprint, requestLogDigest, objectManifestHashes and a rangeDigest that must equal expectedRangeDigest with propfindStatus 207 and rangeStatus 206, which is the fingerprint set this state needs. The dependency tags are complete rather than merely long: app.session, lane.instance, certificate.trust, source.connection, source.session, source.webdav, fixture.corpus and system.permission are each state the connection genuinely rests on, while library.contents, settings.state and ui.navigation are only disturbed by the reset and correctly left out. Its lane device matches all three consumers -- webdav-open-through-loopback, certificate-trust-boundary and webdav-add-source are device-lane -- so no Scenario can demand this state on a lane that cannot produce it. HC-001 is recorded as decided in Config/regression/semantic-authority-decisions.tsv:3 with preauthorized persistent permissions treated as a typed infrastructure interruption, so the system.permission dependency does not leave an undecided question in the path.
